contents.name: Theorem 1.1.1 (functorial embedded resolution via weighted blowings up; functoriality for all smooth morphisms)

contents.reason: The coarse-resolution statement is proved through destackification of tame Deligne-Mumford stacks, which lies far outside this pair's scheme-level scope; the pair records only the scheme-level and stack-free corroboration of functoriality.

contents.name: Sections 2, 5 and 6 (weighted blowings up, the invariant maxinv, the weighted resolution algorithm)
contents.reason: These develop the alternative weighted-blowup algorithm and its invariant. They are genuine independent evidence for the theorem's statement, but the pair's local proof route is the marked-ideal one, so these technical sections are recorded rather than itemized.
